name: Harry Barovsky Memorial Youth Commission
org: City of Malibu Community Services Department
what_you_do: Give the City Council ideas on programs for young people. Plan and run events and activities for youth in Malibu, with help from city staff.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 12 who live or go to school in Malibu.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The city pays no one for serving on its commissions.
deadline_text: Members for 2026-2027 were appointed on June 22, 2026. Next application dates are not posted as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Sign up on the page for email news about the commission. To ask about open seats, call 310-456-2489, ext. 250.
notes: Meetings are the first Thursday of each month, September to June, at 7 p.m. at Malibu City Hall. The page does not explain how to apply.
